api_doc_gaps.resolution: RESOLVED — RPT publishes RequestKeysMissingException/ServiceCodeMissingException in rpt.contract; INT passes them through unchanged
api_doc_gaps.detail: RPT's CheckReportQueryService/DecisionAgreementQueryService now throw the two rpt.contract exceptions (subclasses of ReportStoreException: same codes, same catalog texts, RPT's own advice answers them unchanged); IntegrationProblemAdvice has a dedicated pass-through handler for RequestKeysMissingException. The former part 2 (owners' status/decision enums not in .contract) is re-recorded under the key POST /api/v1/checks/{checkId}/documents.

api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — CheckStatus/EmployeeDecision named by CORE R1 / ADR-INT-013 are not published in chk/rpt .contract, so INT compares the owners' codes AWAITING_DOCUMENTS (RULE-INT-001) and COMPLETED/APPROVED/REJECTED (RULE-INT-002/003, decision endpoint) as strings — pending spec clarification
api_doc_gaps.detail: Fix option: owners publish the status/decision code constants (or enums) in chk.contract / rpt.contract; INT's UploadGuard/ApprovalGuard then use them.

api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — PORTS/error-catalog silent on the INT-502 {status} value for an unreachable host and on a malformed Approval API definition; PORTS' prescribed buildAndExpand(...).encode() contradicts AC-INT-035
api_doc_gaps.detail: (1) Connection failure: {status} = new detail key INT-DETAIL-APPROVAL-UNREACHABLE 'no answer — the host could not be reached' (Arabic PENDING ADR-INT-017) — please confirm or supply the text. (2) An enabled approvalApi that cannot be called (no method/path split, non-token method, path not starting with '/', not exactly one {...} placeholder) is answered INT-500 (integrity failure, never treated as disabled) — REG's RULE-REG-011 checks presence only. (3) UriComponentsBuilder...buildAndExpand(rn).encode() leaves '/' of the request number unencoded (2026/77%20A); INT uses builder.encode().buildAndExpand(rn), which yields 2026%2F77%20A as AC-INT-035 requires — please align PORTS step 1.

api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — api-spec-int.yaml request schemas declare required/maxLength/enum/additionalProperties that the SVC-API-COMMAND unit assigns to the owners; no INT code for an over-length value; unsupported Content-Type now answers INT-400-REQUEST-INVALID; a 415 code is not in the catalog — pending spec clarification
api_doc_gaps.detail: SVC-API (also covers POST /api/v1/checks/{checkId}/decision, POST /api/v1/checks/{checkId}/documents, POST /api/v1/checks/{checkId}/upload-confirmation). (1) StartCheckRequest {serviceCode, requestNumber, employeeId} and DecisionRequest {employeeDecision enum, decidedBy} are required/maxLength 100 in the document, but the unit says presence is decided by the Check Engine (CHK-400-START-INCOMPLETE) and RULE-INT-002/the Report Store (RPT-400-DECISION-INCOMPLETE, AC-INT-038, AC-INT-079 'MAYBE'); bean-validation would preempt those codes and IntegrationProblemAdvice has no MethodArgumentNotValidException mapping, so the DTOs carry NO constraint and values pass as received. A value longer than 100 therefore reaches the owner unchecked; no INT/owner code is listed for it. (2) UploadConfirmationRequest additionalProperties:false is not enforced (unknown JSON members are ignored); no code is listed for a rejected member. (3) Unsupported Content-Type now answers INT-400-REQUEST-INVALID (IntegrationProblemAdvice maps HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException, detail INT-DETAIL-CONTENT-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED; an unsatisfiable Accept header — HttpMediaTypeNotAcceptableException — likewise, detail INT-DETAIL-ACCEPT-UNSUPPORTED); a 415 (or 406) code is not in the catalog. Ask: either drop the constraints from the request schemas or name the refusal codes, and confirm INT-400-REQUEST-INVALID for a wrong Content-Type/Accept or add a 415/406 row.
